faqs.question: What makes Fetchy better than other video downloaders?
faqs.answer: Most downloaders are super basic, they choke on Facebook stories or Instagram carousels. Fetchy handles Instagram reels, multi-photo posts, TikTok slideshows, and even Facebook stories like a champ. Lightweight, fast, and built with real love.

faqs.question: Can I use Fetchy as a Facebook Story Downloader?
faqs.answer: Hell yes! Fetchy isn't just another downloader, it actually supports Facebook story downloads, including those that most tools can't touch. Just paste the story link and let Fetchy work its magic.

faqs.question: Can I download private or expired stories?
faqs.answer: Nah, we play fair. Fetchy only works with public and active content. No creepy stuff. We respect user privacy and platform rules.

faqs.question: Is it free? Will there be annoying ads?
faqs.answer: 100% free. No subscriptions, no popups from hell. Just one clean banner ad to keep the server lights on, your UX stays smooth as silk.

faqs.question: Is it legal to download videos from Instagram, Facebook, or TikTok?
faqs.answer: It depends how you use it. Fetchy is meant for personal use only, like saving your own content or public stuff you have permission to grab. Always respect creators and terms of service.

faqs.question: Why don’t you charge for this?
faqs.answer: Fetchy’s a passion project — built for learning, sharing, and helping people. We believe in giving back. But hey, if you vibe with it, drop a star on GitHub 💖

faqs.question: What content types does Fetchy support from Instagram?

about.title: Download Instagram Reels, Posts & More with Fetchy

parts.p1: Whether it's a viral reel, a carousel post, or a high quality video, Fetchy is your go to Instagram content downloader. No watermarks, no sign ups, no sketchy redirects, just paste the link and download.
parts.p2: Unlike most tools out there, Fetchy is an open source project focused on speed, simplicity, and reliability. It supports reels, post videos, and more content handling, all with clean, instant downloads.
parts.p3: Most Instagram downloaders are packed with popups or make you wait forever. Fetchy is built different, optimized for mobile and desktop links, and designed to skip the nonsense so you get your content fast.
parts.p4: Since Fetchy is open source under the <BSL>BSL 1.1</BSL> license, you’re free to contribute, explore the code, or even run your own instance locally. No ads, no paywalls, just tech that respects you.
parts.p5: Whether you’re backing up your content, saving inspirational clips, or downloading videos for offline viewing, Fetchy makes Instagram downloading easy, safe, and open.

about.title: Download TikTok Videos, Slideshows & Audios with Fetchy

parts.p1: Whether it’s a trending video, a vibey slideshow, or an addicting TikTok sound, Fetchy lets you save it instantly. Just paste the link, hit download, and you’re set no watermark, no app install, no login.
parts.p2: Unlike clunky TikTok saver sites, Fetchy is an open source project built for speed, simplicity, and privacy. It supports all major content types including public videos, slideshows, and standalone audio tracks.
parts.p3: Some newly introduced TikTok features like playlist collections aren’t supported yet, but don’t sweat it we’re actively tracking updates and expanding support fast. Most users already have everything they need.
parts.p4: Fetchy’s backend is fine tuned to handle tricky links like shortened URLs, mobile redirects, and even TikTok share URLs from within the app. It just works, no matter where you’re copying from.
parts.p5: As always, Fetchy is fully open under the <BSL>BSL 1.1</BSL> license. That means you can fork it, contribute, or even run your own instance locally. No paywalls, no rate limits just pure, community powered downloading.
parts.p6: Loved by creators, students, and archivists alike Fetchy is your all in one solution for safe, clean, and hassle free TikTok content saving.

about.title: Download Facebook Videos, Stories & More with Fetchy

parts.p1: Whether it’s a viral video, a story, or a reel, Fetchy is your all in one Facebook content downloader built to handle it all. No watermarks, no slowdowns, no login required, just paste your link and go.
parts.p2: Unlike most tools out there, Fetchy is an open source solution built for speed, simplicity, and reliability. It supports most types of content and delivers clean, fast downloads without the junk. Some formats aren’t supported yet, but we’re actively working on it and everything the average user needs is already good to go.
parts.p3: Most tools either bombard you with ads or limit what you can save. Fetchy flips the script. It’s clean, efficient, and respects your time. Behind the scenes, our backend is optimized to handle even the most complex Facebook URLs, including shortened links, mobile formats, and redirects.
parts.p4: Plus, since Fetchy is open source under the <BSL>BSL 1.1</BSL> license, you’re free to peek under the hood, contribute to the code, or run it yourself, no paywalls, no subscriptions, just community driven tech for everyone.
parts.p5: Perfect for creators, students, and everyday users, Fetchy makes Facebook content downloading effortless and trustworthy.
